mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id, r.app_id, r.role_code FROM na_member_role mr INNER JOIN na_role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.tenant_id = mr.tenant_id WHERE mr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.status = #{roleStatus} AND r.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY r.app_id, r.role_code, r.id

SELECT DISTINCT res.id AS resource_id, res.app_id, res.permission_code FROM na_member_role mr INNER JOIN na_role r ON r.id = mr.role_id AND r.tenant_id = mr.tenant_id INNER JOIN na_role_resource rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.tenant_id = r.tenant_id INNER JOIN na_resource res ON res.id = rr.resource_id WHERE mr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mr.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.status = #{roleStatus} AND r.deleted_at = 0 AND res.status = #{resourceStatus} AND res.deleted_at = 0 AND res.permission_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(res.permission_code) != '' ORDER BY res.app_id, res.permission_code, res.id
